derivation: fun a ha => hN a (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_pow ϖ (Nat.le_add_right N j)) ha)
explanation: The Mathlib lemma converts divisibility of generators into inclusion of their principal ideals. Since ϖ^N divides ϖ^(N+j), membership in the latter ideal implies membership in the former, where hN applies; the given proof uses exactly this argument.
